description: Periodic health summary/ledger. status=LIFECYCLE axis (active/archived); health=POSTURE axis (HEALTHY..CRITICAL). Do NOT conflate — liveness keys on status ONLY, never health.

title.description: Human-readable label for this health record.

status.description: Lifecycle axis — whether this health record is active or archived. Do NOT conflate with health posture.

health.description: Posture axis — current health signal for the tracked surface.

owner.description: Agent or team responsible for this health surface.

summary.description: Free-text narrative of the current health state.
